text.Enflasyon Kredi Faizlerini Nasıl Etkiler: How Does Inflation Affect Loan Interest Rates? - KredimGeldi
text.Enflasyon nedir, nasıl ölçülür ve kredi: What is inflation, how is it measured and how does it affect loan interest rates? We explain the policy rate, real interest and how to factor inflation into your loan decisions.
text.Kredi faizlerinin neden yükselip düştüğü: To understand why loan interest rates rise and fall, you need to look at inflation. Inflation directly affects your money's purchasing power, banks' funding costs and the Central Bank's decisions. All of this is ultimately reflected in the loan interest rate you're offered.
text.Enflasyon nedir, nasıl ölçülür?: What is inflation and how is it measured?
text.Yıllık enflasyon, bu ayki endeksin geçen: Annual inflation is the percentage change in this month's index compared with the index for the same month last year:
text.Yıllık enflasyon = (Bu ayın TÜFE'si ÷ Ge: Annual inflation = (This month's CPI ÷ CPI for the same month last year − 1) × 100
text.Enflasyon ile faiz arasındaki bağ: The link between inflation and interest rates
text.Politika faizindeki değişiklikler kredi: Changes in the policy rate aren't reflected in loan interest rates immediately, but usually within a few weeks or months. Banks gradually update their rates based on their deposit costs and risk expectations.
text.Reel faiz: Kredinin gerçek yükü: Real interest: The true burden of a loan
text.Reel faiz ≈ (1 + yıllık kredi maliyeti): Real interest ≈ (1 + annual loan cost) ÷ (1 + annual inflation) − 1
text.Enflasyon yüksekken sabit taksitle ödene: When inflation is high, the real burden of a debt repaid in fixed installments shrinks over time, because the installment amount stays the same while incomes usually rise. However, this rests on the assumption that your income rises along with inflation. If your income is fixed or lags behind inflation, this advantage disappears: the installment stays the same while your other expenses go up, so your budget gets tighter.
text.Kredi kararlarınızda enflasyonu nasıl he: How should you factor inflation into your loan decisions?
text.Güncel faiz oranlarıyla taksitlerinizi h: Calculate your installments right away with current interest rates.
text.TÜİK, tüketici fiyat endeksini her ayın: TÜİK (the Turkish Statistical Institute) releases the consumer price index at the beginning of each month, with the data for the previous month.
text.Politika faizi düşerse mevcut kredimin f: If the policy rate falls, will the interest on my existing loan go down?
text.Sabit faizli kredilerde hayır; taksitler: Not for fixed-rate loans; your installments continue as set out in your contract. New loans, however, may benefit from lower interest rates over time.
text.Reel faiz negatif olursa ne anlama gelir: What does a negative real interest rate mean?
text.Kredi maliyetinin enflasyonun altında ka: It shows that the cost of the loan is below inflation, meaning the real value of the debt erodes over time.

html.Enflasyon, mal ve hizmet fiyatlarının ge: Inflation is a sustained increase in the general level of prices for goods and services. In Türkiye, official inflation is measured by the Consumer Price Index (CPI), published every month by TÜİK (the Turkish Statistical Institute). The CPI tracks the price change of a basket of goods and services consumed by a typical household, such as food, rent, transportation and energy.
html.Merkez Bankası, enflasyonu kontrol altın: The Central Bank uses the policy rate to keep inflation under control. When inflation rises, the policy rate is usually raised; this increases banks' borrowing costs and is passed on to loan interest rates. More expensive loans reduce demand, spending slows and the pace of price increases falls. When inflation recedes, rate cuts come onto the agenda and loan interest rates also come down over time.
html.Kredinin enflasyondan arındırılmış maliy: The cost of a loan adjusted for inflation is called real interest. Simply put, it's found by removing the effect of annual inflation from the annual loan cost:
html.<strong>Sabit faiz avantajını değerlendi: Make the most of the fixed-rate advantage. Personal and vehicle loans have fixed rates; your installment won't change even if rates rise later.
html.<strong>Geliriniz enflasyona endeksli mi: Is your income indexed to inflation? Whether your salary increases keep up with inflation determines the burden of a long-term debt.
html.<strong>Faiz indirimi beklentisiyle kara: Don't put off decisions waiting for rate cuts. Expectations may not materialize. If your need is real, consider the offer that fits your budget under today's conditions; if rates fall significantly, you can look into early repayment or refinancing.
html.<strong>Fiyat artışını hesaba katın.</st: Factor in price increases. If you're using a loan to buy something whose price changes quickly, like a home or a car, add the cost of waiting to your calculation.
